NFL:nfl.fantasy_component_and_stack_cova.notes: No NFL player/pbp archive in any ledger; free nflverse data exists, must be pulled. Correlations estimated strictly from prior games.

NFL:nfl.weekly_leader_threshold_distribu.notes: Not in any ledger; fully free and backfillable. Weather columns in games.csv are free. Only pull/encode needed.

needs: own market-free team ratings built from scores
NFL:nfl.schedule_strength.notes: Core input is schedule plus own ratings from scores; no NFL results archive yet. Market win-total comparison is a benchmark only, not needed. Future schedule known pregame.

needs: nflverse pbp 2 seasons+ (yardline_100, down, pass, score_differential)
NFL:nfl.goal_to_go_pass_rate.limiting_source_or_reason: nflverse-data GitHub releases (probed REACHABLE: pbp 2003/2024, snaps, injuries)
NFL:nfl.goal_to_go_pass_rate.notes: Pure pbp aggregation; pbp not yet pulled into any ledger. Coach identity from games.csv.

needs: nflverse pbp (drives, score state, qtr, time)
NFL:nfl.market_free_score_state_blowout_.limiting_source_or_reason: nflverse-data GitHub releases (probed REACHABLE: pbp 2003/2024, snaps, injuries)
NFL:nfl.market_free_score_state_blowout_.notes: Free pbp and games data suffice; betting columns explicitly dropped. Depends on other derived inputs (ratings, lattice) that must be built first.

needs: nflverse pbp yardline_100, penalty, punt fields
NFL:nfl.own_one_yard_line_snap_rate.limiting_source_or_reason: nflverse-data GitHub releases (probed REACHABLE: pbp 2003/2024, snaps, injuries)
NFL:nfl.own_one_yard_line_snap_rate.notes: Count of yardline_100=99 snaps from pbp; free, 1999+, not yet pulled.

needs: pregame active/inactive status vintages (injuries, depth charts)
NFL:nfl.game_fantasy_max_field_sim.limiting_source_or_reason: nflverse injuries/depth charts (history) + ESPN injuries feed (snapshot only)
NFL:nfl.game_fantasy_max_field_sim.notes: All free. Historical status via nflverse injuries/depth_charts; live pregame status must be captured prospectively. Needs component model from covariance input.

NFL:nfl.score_resid.limiting_source_or_reason: Residual defined relative to market lines (market-derived benchmark)
NFL:nfl.score_resid.notes: Uses closing spread/total as the reference, so it is a benchmark not a market-free input.

NFL:m.volume_oi.notes: Volume/OI are market-derived; benchmark/execution weight only.

needs: CFBD plays and player season stats (free key) or cfbfastR-data pbp or ESPN CFB summary plays
CFB:cfb.qb_rushing.limiting_source_or_reason: CFBD (host denied from runner, key free); ESPN summary reachable
CFB:cfb.qb_rushing.notes: espn_cfb ledger holds only scores, no plays. Free play data exists; designed-run vs scramble split needs play-text parsing. Sack counting caveats noted.

needs: depth chart / injury status vintages (prospective capture)
CFB:cfb.qb_availability_hazard.limiting_source_or_reason: CFBD/ESPN box scores (history); no historical CFB injury vintages
CFB:cfb.qb_availability_hazard.notes: Base rate and mobility multiplier backfillable from participation; current-status/injury flag must be captured prospectively (ESPN injuries is snapshot-only). No mandatory CFB injury reports exist.

needs: CFP protocol/format rules by season (public docs)
CFB:cfb.playoff_format.notes: Public rules text; must be hand-encoded per season (4-team to 12-team, seeding changes). Nothing computed yet.

CFB:cfb.transfer_destination_candidate_m.limiting_source_or_reason: Reported interest timeline and compensation are not free/structured; 247/On3 detail is paywalled/scrape-fragile
CFB:cfb.transfer_destination_candidate_m.notes: Portal entries and commits are free, but credible timestamped interest reports, visits and NIL capacity have no free structured historical source. Compensation imputation only partly mitigates.

needs: CFBD returning production and portal endpoints (free key)
CFB:cfb.roster_continuity.notes: Free key source; host denied from this runner but exists. Alternatively derive from ESPN box scores. Not yet pulled.

CFB:cfb.completion_yardage_profile.limiting_source_or_reason: No free CFB air-yards/YAC; PFF/SIS paid, CFBD limited
CFB:cfb.completion_yardage_profile.notes: Yards per completion and 20+/40+ rates are free via plays, but depth of target and YAC are the stated content and lack free full-coverage data. Fallback approximation would not be the input itself.

needs: player season stats by regular season 2010-2025 (CFBD/NCAA leaderboards)
CFB:cfb.counting_stat_tie_mass.limiting_source_or_reason: CFBD player season stats; NCAA stats leaderboards
CFB:cfb.counting_stat_tie_mass.notes: Free leaderboards exist; needs scraping/pull and simulation. Half-unit sack lattice is in NCAA data.

CFB:cfb.defender_production_profile.limiting_source_or_reason: Pressures and pass-rush snaps are PFF-only (paid); sacks/TFL free
CFB:cfb.defender_production_profile.notes: Sacks/TFL by game are free, but the profile's pressure and pass-rush-snap-rate components have no free source.

CFB:cfb.officials.limiting_source_or_reason: NONE_FOUND reliable crew assignment feed (catalog); penalties are post-hoc only
CFB:cfb.officials.notes: Pregame crew assignments are not published in a reliable free feed; conference-level fallback is a different input. Post-hoc crews in some ESPN summaries are sparse/unverified.

CFB:cfb.qb_sack_proneness.notes: Raw sacks per dropback is free, but the line-independent decomposition needs pressures and time-to-throw, which are paid-only.

CFB:cfb.snap_weighted_availability_loss.limiting_source_or_reason: No free per-game CFB snaps; no official CFB availability reports
CFB:cfb.snap_weighted_availability_loss.notes: CFBD usage is season-level, not per-game snaps; timestamped report history cannot be backfilled and needs own capture. Snap-share core data absent.

CFB:cfb.team_total_split.notes: Implied team means from spread and total are market prices; benchmark not market-free input.

CFB:m.trade_tape.notes: Executed trades are market-derived; benchmark/execution analysis only.
